judged_text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:44-49 — `perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` to opportunistically pull the whole RSS feed on every uncached embed request without checking `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present?` first, so if feed_polling_enabled is on but URL is blank this silently no-ops deep inside PollFeed rather than being validated at the call site, and the whole feed is re-fetched synchronously per cold visitor request instead of only the target article.

adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb `perform_retrieve` unconditionally calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` whenever `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, without checking `feed_polling_url.present?` / `embed_by_username.present?` at the call site. `Jobs::PollFeed#execute` does guard those settings, so a blank URL just becomes a no-op inside PollFeed (not a correctness defect). However, calling PollFeed synchronously from a web-triggered retrieval path can re-fetch and process the entire RSS feed (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` and iterating `rss.items`) on cold embed requests, which is a real performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff.
